law: A refusal that is waiting on a HUMAN decision must name that decision here, and the wait must be machine-checkable. Before this file, 'blocked on Joe' lived in prose in three handoffs and nothing re-checked it -- so an item could be decided and the refusal would keep holding, or the refusal could hold on a reason that had already been overtaken. An item moves to APPROVED or DECLINED only by a human editing this file; the NO_SIGNOFF precondition in refusal_preconditions.py reads it every run, and a refusal still standing on an APPROVED item FAILS the scoreboard.

items.joe_quote: if a column is totally in sync with its peers from 2000-2025, then it can be trusted for its other values as well. Keep in mind it might have sparser data on earlier years so if it has a 0 or null or blank those values are not necessarily true, but positive values can be trusted
items.ruling: ROOT CREDIBILITY LAW: a source vouched >=95% on closed modern ground (2000-2025, or closed overlapping eras for sources with no modern data) may backfill POSITIVE values into NULL cells in sparse eras. Zeros/NULLs/blanks from sparse coverage are NEVER testimony -- positive values only.
